# Legal Information Institute (LII)

> > The Legal Information Institute provides free public access to U.S. legal resources including the Code of Federal Regulations, United States Code, Supreme Court opinions, and specialized legal collections.

Operated by Cornell Law School, LII is a leading online legal research platform offering comprehensive federal regulations, statutes, case law, and educational materials. The site serves legal professionals, students, and the public with authoritative legal information and specialized collections on topics ranging from administrative law to civil procedure.

## Key Topics

- Code of Federal Regulations (CFR)
- Federal Register
- Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR)
- United States Code
- Administrative law
- Presidential documents and executive orders
- Document filing and publication requirements
- Government publishing
- Supreme Court cases
- Civil procedure
- Legal education
- Cornell Law School
- Office of the Federal Register
- Terrorism law
- Legal Information Institute (LII)

## Federal Regulations and Administrative Law

- [Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR): Table Of Contents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text): Main table of contents for Electronic Code of Federal Regulations
- [1 CFR Part 2 - General Information](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/part-2): General information on Federal Register and CFR administration
- [1 CFR § 5.1 - Publication policy](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.1): Federal Register publication policy and filing requirements
- [1 CFR § 5.2 - Documents required to be filed](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.2): Requirements for Federal Register document filing and publication
- [1 CFR § 5.9 - Categories of documents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.9): Federal Register document classification and categories
- [1 CFR § 51.1 - Policy](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/51.1): Federal Register incorporation by reference policy and approval
- [1 CFR § 5.5 - Supplement to the Code of Federal Regulations](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.5): CFR supplement publication through daily Federal Register

## Specialized Legal Collections

- [LII's Focus on Terrorism Law](https://www.law.cornell.edu/background/terrorism.htm): Collection of terrorism law statutes, executive orders, and resources
- [Civil Procedure Stories - Briefs & Such](https://civprostories.law.cornell.edu/): Archival legal briefs and documents from Erie R.R. v. Tompkins case
- [LII Bulletin Topics](https://www.law.cornell.edu/bulletin/topics.htm): Topic index for legal commentary on commercial and enterprise law

## Legal Education and Research

- [Breaking Out of Legal Education's Box](https://www.law.cornell.edu/background/distance/otb): Article on legal education reform and distance learning initiatives

## Optional

- [1 CFR § 11.2 - Federal Register](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/11.2): CFR regulation on Federal Register subscription pricing and access
- [1 CFR § 5.10 - Forms of publication](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.10): CFR regulation on Federal Register publication formats and distribution
- [1 CFR § 5.3 - Publication of other documents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.3): Director authority for Federal Register publication of other documents
- [1 CFR § 5.4 - Publication not authorized](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.4): Federal Register publication restrictions and exclusions
- [1 CFR § 5.7 - Delivery and mailing](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.7): Federal Register delivery requirements and distribution schedule
- [LodLive - browsing the Web of Data](https://demo.law.cornell.edu/ag-lod/): Demo of LodLive RDF browser for linked data visualization
